arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Crabtree argued that disparate impact is a valid method of proof in age cases.
Mr. Nager argued that the Age Discrimination Act does not support disparate impact claims.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests whether the Age Discrimination in Employment Act permits disparate impact claims. the sides that brought the case argue the statute bans facially neutral actions that harm older workers. the opposing sides contend the law only prohibits intentional age bias.
